summary: Add wrapper-kind rules for genie-freshness, typescript-client and isolation-vm to the evidence skip policy

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change; three entries in a policy file read from the accepted base.

rules.detail: No required check, daemon rule or main landing change. These rules only let a note that a producer signs for the exact tree count; nothing skips until such a note exists.

compatibility.detail: Policy data only; existing rules are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Removing the three entries restores observed-only acceptance for those checks.
